mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, description, is_public, video_count, cover_url, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collect_folder (user_id, name, description, is_public, video_count, cover_url, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{isPublic}, 0, '', #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM collect_folder WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE collect_folder SET video_count = GREATEST(video_count + #{increment}, 0), cover_url = IF(#{coverUrl} IS NOT NULL AND #{coverUrl} != '', #{coverUrl}, cover_url) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE collect_folder SET video_count = video_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE collect_folder SET video_count = GREATEST(video_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
